body.baselineNote: Linear extrapolation of the observed Sen's-slope trend over 2000–2025 (full years in the database), from the 2000–2025 mean as baseline: a statistical outlook, not a climate-model projection (no RCP / SSP scenarios are in the database). The spec's 1991–2020 normal is not available (the record starts in 2000, DECISIONS D3). The further the year, the less the extrapolation means. Risk level = change by 2050 in the adverse direction ÷ the record's interannual standard deviation (< 0.5 Low, < 1 Moderate, < 2 High, else Very High); an insignificant trend is Low.
body.title: Climate risk outlook 2050: trend extrapolation

rows.basis: Change by 2050 above 2 standard deviations of the record
Change by 2050 between 1 and 2 standard deviations of the record
